verdict.rationale: A public status page with uptime history and incident postmortems is a fair question for a hosted web-data API, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack mentions a status page, uptime history, SLA reporting, or published postmortems. The rate-limit and timeout docs cover request handling, not service reliability transparency, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As a data-engineer, I can check a public status page showing uptime history and past incident postmortems before committing to the service
